Author: t3sco (based on Mappy by MidoriKami, harbingerftw)
Name: Gratis
Description: Replaces the in-game map with a flat, minimal ImGui map: search, lenses, filters, travel offers, window presets and dozens of small QoL tweaks. Based on Mappy by MidoriKami and harbingerftw. Open with /gratis.
Changelog: Gratis is now in the official Dalamud testing channel: tick 'Get plugin testing builds' in /xlsettings > Experimental, install Gratis from /xlplugins, then remove this custom repository URL so you don't get two copies. New: FATE button and list on the map, gold + for EXP-bonus FATEs, pet and striking dummy markers in the Gratis style.
